message: A task can now depend on another task’s answer. In the task editor, Only if picks a task that asks a Yes/No or Pick one question and the answers that should show this task. Until the question is answered it waits, like any task waiting on another. After that, any other answer marks it Not needed: it leaves your lists, stops counting toward its project, and sits under its own heading in Search. Template items have the same Only if, pointing at another item in the template.
